Project Update: The Horten Mystery ​

Theme: Behind the scenes of the development.

Our project is a journey into the heart of power and its concealment. Here, the process of how "The Horten Mystery" is created is documented.

  • Status: The concept for the 4-part mockumentary is in place.
  • Characters: Birgit Minichmayr, August Diehl, and Oliver Masucci form the artistic backbone.
  • Core Concept: Pointillism of Capital.

Documented by Volti Sodala & Gemini CLI.
